observations: Black slim-profile game console wrapped in clear plastic film.
One black wireless controller with PlayStation logo on the center button.
Watermark 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' present on all images.
Camera watermark 'SHOT ON REDMI 7 AI DUAL CAMERA' at the bottom.

claims.evidence: The hardware design in photos 0, 1, and 2 matches the PS4 Slim revision.
No photo of the system software version or homebrew software is provided.
The screen is not shown; games cannot be confirmed.
A UK power plug is shown, but this does not prove the console's history.
The plastic wrap obscures the actual surface of the console, potentially hiding scratches.

risks.risk: The console may be on a firmware version higher than 9.00, making it unhackable.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the software version.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive may be the base 500GB instead of 1TB.
The optical disc drive may not read discs.
risks.proof: Video of a game disc being inserted and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty disc drive

risks.risk: The controller may be a third-party replica.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sticker on the back of the controller.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the Storage screen showing the HDD capacity.
Photo of the home screen showing the installed games.
Video of the console booting up and loading a game.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PS4 Slim. It will be priced at the worst-case scenario (unhacked, 500GB, standard used condition) until the seller provides proof of the jailbreak and storage capacity.
